# Project Notes

- This is a React + Vite storefront using JavaScript and plain CSS.
- Keep the catalogue and editable store information in `src/data/` rather than embedding it in components.
- Prices, inventory, customer stories and contact information must remain clearly marked as demo/placeholders until verified by the business.
- The cart is browser-local. Do not imply that an order was sent, confirmed or paid; WhatsApp is an enquiry handoff only.
- The Contact form is front-end only until a real mail service or backend is configured.
- Use semantic HTML, labelled form controls, responsive layouts and reduced-motion support.
- Install dependencies with `npm install`; run locally with `npm run dev`; verify production output with `npm run build`.
